name: Geo-11
description: 3DMigoto-based stereo injector for D3D11/D3D12 games. The primary platform for modern stereo fixes — most active community fixes target Geo-11.

v0.6.56.notes: Standard stable release. Most game fixes target this version.

v0.6.60.23-beta.notes: Beta with native SR Weave output. No mainline game fixes currently use this version yet.

v0.6.196.notes: Default from the Geo-11 website. Newer than v0.6.56 but fewer tested fixes.
